mechanics.name: Bound by Obsession
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you see the Killer's Aura. While the Killer sees your Aura, you Bless and Cleanse Totems, heal, and repair 8/9/10% faster. While you are the Obsession, every 30 seconds the Killer sees your Aura for 4 seconds. At Trial start, you are more likely to become the Obsession.
activation: The mutual Aura and action-speed effects activate whenever the Killer sees your Aura.
If you are the Obsession, the Killer sees your Aura every 30 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The mutual Aura and action-speed effects end when the Killer stops seeing your Aura.
Ends/deactivates when: Each periodic Obsession Aura reveal lasts 4 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Increased periodic Obsession Aura reveal from 3 to 4 seconds and increased the linked action-speed bonus from 2/4/6% to 8/9/10%, adding Blessing to the affected Totem actions.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: When the Killer can read your Aura, you can read theirs and perform several actions faster; as the Obsession, you periodically reveal yourself to the Killer.
duration: Obsession Aura reveal: 4 seconds every 30 seconds.
specialInteractions: The 8/9/10% bonus applies to Blessing, Cleansing, Healing, and Repairing while the Killer sees your Aura.
At Trial start, you are more likely to be selected as the Obsession.

editorial.summary: Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, see theirs back and gain up to 10% speed to repairs, healing, and Totem interactions; the Obsession exposes their Aura every 30 seconds.
useCases: Turn Killer Aura-reading perks into reciprocal information.
Use the periodic Obsession reveal to gain repeated Killer Aura windows.
Exploit the temporary 8/9/10% action-speed boost while the Aura interaction is active.
counters: The Killer also sees you during the scheduled Obsession reveal.
Aura-blocking and Undetectable can reduce the information exchange.
The periodic reveal can be dangerous when you are already vulnerable.
pros: Punishes Aura-heavy Killer builds with reciprocal information.
Provides a small action-speed bonus during reveal windows.
Can intentionally feed We See You tokens.
cons: Much less appealing for stealth-oriented players.
Value depends on Killer Aura-reading behavior.
analysis: Bound by Obsession gained a meaningful numerical upgrade in 10.2. The reciprocal Aura mechanic remains, but the action-speed bonus during those windows now reaches 10% and includes blessing as well as cleansing, healing, and repairing.

As Obsession, the periodic reveal now lasts four seconds. That creates a predictable information trade: the Killer sees you, you see them, and you gain a short burst of productive action speed if you are working at the time.
The risk is still real. Sometimes the Killer benefits more from knowing your location than you benefit from seeing theirs, especially if the reveal occurs while you are vulnerable.
The buff improves the reward side of that trade enough that the perk deserves reconsideration upward, particularly in confident information-heavy builds.
editorial.verdict: A stronger reciprocal-Aura perk in 10.2. The danger remains, but 10% action speed and four-second periodic reads make the reward much more credible.
